title: Franklin Templeton Officially Launches 2 Bitcoin DRIP ETFs That Turn Dividends Into Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Franklin Templeton Officially Launches 2 Bitcoin DRIP ETFs That Turn Dividends Into Bitcoin Franklin Templeton’s two Bitcoin DRIP ETFs, FBEQ and FIBT, started trading today on the Nasdaq. This post Franklin Templeton Officially Launches 2 Bitcoin DRIP ETFs That Turn Dividends Into Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
